context: Saito explains a recovery course to a patient.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical explanation; vocabulary (大学院/医学/書籍/経過/筆者) in natural home.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 先生、回復の経過は順調ですか?
lines.en: Doctor, is my recovery progressing well?
lines.style: concerned office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、経過はとても良好です。
lines.en: Yes, your progress is very good.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 医学では、よくあることですか?
lines.style: curious office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 医学的に、典型的な経過です。
lines.style: clear doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 何か、読める書籍はありますか?
lines.en: Is there a book I can read?
lines.style: attentive office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: やさしい書籍を、お貸ししますよ。
lines.en: I'll lend you an accessible book.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 筆者は、お医者さんですか?
lines.style: curious office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、大学院で学んだ筆者の本です。
lines.en: Yes, it's by an author who trained in grad school.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
